note: Maldives, read on Maldives Immigration's Work Visa page (immigration.gov.mv, updated 6 September 2026) on 2026-10-30. A Work Visa authorises an expatriate to reside and work in the Maldives; since 23 November 2025 it is an e-Visa only, which the employer or its representative obtains through the Xpat Online System within 15 days of the employee's arrival on an Entry Pass (Work Permit) issued by the Ministry of Homeland Security and Technology (applied for in country). It runs with the employer's approved work permit (work for the sponsor), and renewed Work Visas are issued for one year at most (the term kept). The page states no fee (the work permit's fees are the employer's) and no decision time; permanent residence and naturalisation aren't on it.

sources.title: Maldives Immigration, Work Visa
sources.said: A Work Visa authorizes expatriates to reside and work in the Maldives. ... The employer or authorized representative must apply for and obtain the Work e-Visa within fifteen (15) days of the employee's arrival in the Maldives on a valid Entry Pass (Work Permit) issued by the Ministry of Homeland Security and Technology. ... The validity of the Work e-Visa will correspond directly to the validity of the approved Work Permit . ... Renewed Work Visas will be issued with a maximum validity of one (1) year .
